notes: Clear, well-scoped brief. Tests full recall and that unstated compliance and payment details become questions, not facts.
input: We need patients to book, reschedule and cancel appointments online with any of our 12 doctors across 3 clinics. Patients should get an SMS reminder 24 hours before their appointment. Front-desk staff need a daily schedule view per doctor and must be able to block time off. Cancellations less than 2 hours before the slot should be flagged as late cancellations.

questionsAbout: how patients sign in or verify identity
whether a payment or deposit is taken at booking
what happens after a late cancellation
mustNotInvent: payment at booking stated as explicit
a named regulation (HIPAA, GDPR) stated as explicit
